description.en: The ID of the basic GA instance.

description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **request ID** as the **client token**. The **request ID** may be different for each request.

description.zh:

The ID of the acceleration region.

You can call the [GetBasicAccelerator](~~2253380~~) operation to query the region ID.

description.zh: 全球加速所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**。
description.en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

title.zh: 为基础型全球加速实例创建加速IP

descriptions.zh:
- **CreateBasicAccelerateIp**接口属于异步接口，即系统会先返回一个请求ID，但基础型全球加速实例加速IP未创建完成，系统后台的创建任务仍在进行。您可以调用[GetBasicAccelerateIp](~~466794~~)查询加速IP的状态：
    - 当不返回状态信息时，表示加速IP正在创建中，在该状态下，您只能执行查询操作，不能执行其他操作。
    - 当加速IP处于**active**状态时，表示加速IP创建完成。
- **CreateBasicAccelerateIp**接口不支持在同一个基础型全球加速实例内并发创建加速IP。
descriptions.en:
*   **CreateBasicAccelerateIp** is an asynchronous operation. After you send a request, the system returns a request ID, but the operation is still being performed in the system background. You can call the [GetBasicAccelerateIp](~~466794~~) operation to query the status of an accelerated IP address:

    *   If no status information is returned, the accelerated IP address is being created. In this case, you can perform only query operations.
    *   If the accelerated IP address is in the **active** state, the accelerated IP address is created.

*   The **CreateBasicAccelerateIp** operation cannot be repeatedly called for the same GA instance within a specific period of time.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga create-basic-accelerate-ip --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --accelerator-id ga-bp17frjjh0udz4qz0000 --ip-set-id ips-bp11r5jb8ogp122xl0000 --region cn-hangzhou
